summary: Comprehensive testing of ACTOOS ONE multi-country super-app. Tested 14 features across Mali and Senegal. 13/14 features PASS. Admin email login continues to fail (Supabase auth issue - same as iterations 87-89).

critical.issue: Admin login (contact@actoos.com / Salifkane&&7) returns 'Invalid login credentials'. Admin account may not exist in Supabase Auth or password is incorrect.

ui_bugs.issue: Cookie consent popup keeps reappearing even after accepting. localStorage key 'actoos_cookies_accepted' is set but popup still shows on page reload.

action_items: CRITICAL: Create/verify admin account (contact@actoos.com) in Supabase Auth with password 'Salifkane&&7'
FIX: Cookie consent popup persistence - check localStorage key handling in CookieConsentSheet component
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-country architecture is well implemented with countriesConfig.js
AuthContext.jsx correctly handles multi-country phone validation
Restaurant filtering by city/country works correctly
TouchPay integration is in DEMO mode (no real API keys configured)

success_rate.backend: N/A - Supabase auth issue for admin

context_for_next_testing_agent: All multi-country features working. Admin login fails due to Supabase auth issue. Cookie consent popup has persistence bug. TouchPay and Twilio are MOCKED.

test_1_client_signup_mali.details: Signup form shows Mali flag 🇲🇱, +223 code, phone placeholder '70 00 00 00'. Form has: Nom complet *, Phone *, Email (optionnel), Mot de passe *

test_2_client_signup_senegal.details: Country dropdown shows all 10 West African countries. Selecting Senegal changes code to +221 and placeholder to '77 000 00 00'

test_3_client_login_phone.details: Login sheet has Téléphone | Email tabs. Phone login form has country selector, phone input, password input, 'Mot de passe oublié ?' link

test_4_client_login_email.details: Email tab shows email input, password input, submit button. Form validation works correctly.

test_5_admin_login.details: Admin login with contact@actoos.com / Salifkane&&7 fails with 'Invalid login credentials'. This is a Supabase auth data issue, not frontend bug.

test_6_restaurants_bamako.details: Homepage shows 16 restaurants from Bamako: Maquis Chez Tanti, Fast Food Bamako, Pizza Mama Africa, Grillades de Bamako, Cafe de Paris Bamako, Poulet Braise Express, Shawarma King, Thieboudienne House, etc.

test_7_restaurants_dakar.details: After changing location to Dakar, Senegal restaurants appear: Chez Fatou - Thieboudienne, Dibiterie Ndoye. Total 4 restaurants in Dakar as expected.

test_8_order_flow.details: Restaurant detail page shows menu categories (Accompagnements, Boissons, Burgers). Items display with name, description, price in FCFA. Add to cart functionality visible.

test_9_wallet_screen.details: ACTOOS Pay wallet shows: Solde disponible (0 FCFA), Recharger button, Envoyer button, Payer (QR) button, Encaisser (QR) button. Tabs: Historique, Sous-comptes, Cartes

test_10_touchpay_topup.details: TouchPay recharge sheet shows amount options (1,000 F, 2,000 F, 5,000 F, 10,000 F), 'Autre montant' option, phone field with +223, 'Confirmer la recharge' button. DEMO MODE active.

test_11_country_selector.details: Country dropdown in login/signup shows: 🇲🇱 Mali +223, 🇸🇳 Sénégal +221, 🇨🇮 Côte d'Ivoire +225, 🇧🇫 Burkina Faso +226, 🇬🇳 Guinée +224, and more. Search functionality available.

test_12_location_change.details: 'Ajouter une adresse' selector allows changing between Bamako and Dakar. Restaurant list updates based on selected city.

test_13_promotions.details: Homepage shows promotional banners: 'Livraison gratuite' (code LIVGRATUITE), '10 pourcent de réduction' (code ACTOOS10)

test_14_bottom_navigation.details: Bottom navigation has 3 tabs: Eats (restaurants), Wallet (ACTOOS Pay), Profil (user profile/login)

mocked_apis.TouchPay Mobile Money: MOCKED - Demo mode, no real API keys configured
mocked_apis.Twilio SMS OTP: MOCKED - OTP code displayed in UI for testing (devCode field)

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Admin email login fails with 'Invalid login credentials'
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The admin account (contact@actoos.com) either doesn't exist in Supabase Auth or has a different password than 'Salifkane&&7'. This has been reported in iterations 87, 88, and 89.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Create admin account in Supabase Auth dashboard with email: contact@actoos.com and password: Salifkane&&7. Ensure the account has admin role in the users table.
